g.text: 盟军远征 / 渡口防线
线列 / 楔形 / 纵队
渡口已清空。指挥官，车队可以过桥了。

svg.script: let active=-1;function tab(i){active=active===i?-1:i;for(let j=0;j<6;j++){for(const p of ['mark','cat'])document.getElementById(p+j).setAttribute('display',j===active?'inline':'none')}document.getElementById('roster').setAttribute('transform',active===-1?'translate(0 198)':'translate(0 313) scale(1 .81)')}function orders(){const o=document.getElementById('orders'),hide=o.getAttribute('display')!=='none';o.setAttribute('display',hide?'none':'inline');document.getElementById('fold').textContent=hide?'展开 ▴':'收起 ▾'}const radar=document.getElementById('radar');function locate(e){const p=new DOMPoint(e.clientX,e.clientY).matrixTransform(radar.getScreenCTM().inverse());const x=Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(512,p.x-384))),y=Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(288,p.y-216)));document.getElementById('camera').setAttribute('viewBox',[x,y,768,432].join(' '));const box=document.getElementById('outline');box.setAttribute('x',x);box.setAttribute('y',y);}radar.onpointerdown=e=>{if(e.button!==0)return;radar.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);locate(e)};radar.onpointermove=e=>{if(radar.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId)&&e.buttons===1)locate(e)};
